evidence: DLR gapped +11.0% in a single session on 2026-07-24 (179.34 → 199.08)

The tagged headline itself frames the question as whether DLR is 'fully priced'
findings.risk: Guidance raises for capital-intensive data-centre REITs often trigger a multi-day upgrade cycle and positive post-announcement drift, which can extend outperformance versus SPY through the exit open.

Entry is after the gap, so I buy the multiple, not the earnings. SELL held at low size.

evidence: DLR shocked +11.0% on 2026-07-24, close 179.34 -> 199.08 — an extreme single-session move for a capital-intensive REIT
The headline itself asks 'Is Digital Realty Trust (DLR) Fully Priced As Higher Guidance Lifts Optimism?' — the guidance raise is the known, priced news
DLR matched 'upgrade' in a Wall Street analyst-calls headline, confirming the re-rating catalyst is public and largely absorbed
findings.risk: Guidance raises trigger multi-day analyst upgrade cycles and positive post-announcement drift; the upgrade headline shows that cycle has begun, and AI-datacenter momentum could extend DLR past SPY.

Second-order point the council missed: externally-funded datacenter REITs typically raise equity into price pops — an issuance overhang the market hasn't priced. SPY rises with the same AI complex, so DLR must extend a historic REIT move to win. Consolidation/profit-taking is the base case; I side with the sellers.
